requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5231-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5231-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

116-765-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-765-2645-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2301-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2301-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

116-215-2404-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
116-215-2404-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Kiora's Follower any number of times.

997-3249-5173-5334.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

4771-5660-7692.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2921-3605-4812-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-4742-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

628-2292-7188.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1322-1563-3899-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3885-4050-4052-6518.description:
Cast Stinkweed Imp by paying {B} due to The Sibsig Ceremony.
When Stinkweed Imp enters, The Sibsig Ceremony and Kindred Discovery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stinkweed Imp, adding {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, failing to destroy Stinkweed Imp as it's no longer on the battlefield and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Resolve the Kindred Discovery trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return Stinkweed Imp from your graveyard to your hand due to Stinkweed Imp's dredge ability.
Repeat.

186-3918-4131.description:
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat

643-2921-4338.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

224-1193-1846-3584-6657.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1193-1846-3584-6657.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers. 
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Thousand-Year Storm ability.
Resolve the copy of Thousand-Year Storm's ability, copying the Mythos of Illuna spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Mythos of Illuna, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.
224-1193-1846-3584-6657.notes: If you've cast an instant or sorcery spell prior to starting this combo, you will create an additional copy of Mythos of Illuna each iteration that can target any applicable permanent. You will also get a copy of High Tide when you cast it, causing you to add an additional {U}{U} when tapping the Islands instead of {U}.

1357-1534-4697.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1357-1534-4697.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying its mana cost, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
1357-1534-4697.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

1052-3967-6553.easyPrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
1052-3967-6553.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

261-1274-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-1274-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-3284-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3284-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

2079-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2079-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

1621-5241.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Sakashima's Student.
1621-5241.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Sakashima's Student. Choose to have Sakashima's Student enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

204-776-3923.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least three creatures without summoning sickness.
204-776-3923.description:
Activate three creatures you control by tapping them, adding {2}{U} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Mystic Speculation to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control four or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

1364-1371-2899-4398.description:
Cast Endless Swarm by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Eye of the Storm and Hive Mind trigger.
Resolve the Eye of the Storm trigger, exiling Endless Swarm, and then copying each instant and sorcery card exiled with Eye of the Storm, and allowing you to cast the copies without paying their mana costs.
Choose not to cast the copy of Endless Swarm as permitted by Eye of the Storm.
Resolve the Hive Mind trigger from step 2, causing each opponent to copy Endless Swarm.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Endless Swarm, causing them to create a 1/1 Snake creature token for each card in their hand, and then be unable to cast spells for the rest of the game.
The Snakes enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Endless Swarm copy.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, their copy of Endless Swarm triggers, copying itself.
Resolve the copy of Endless Swarm, causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Snake creature token for each card in their hand.
The Snakes enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 9.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-1749-3175-3556-4074.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Chandra's ability this turn.
1031-1749-3175-3556-4074.description:
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Arcavios.
Invasion of Arcavios triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Invocation of the Founders.
Activate Chandra's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Invocation of the Founders.
Chandra and Invocation of the Founders trigger, copying Flicker twice, with one copy targeting Chandra and the other targeting Sun Titan.
Resolve the first Flicker copy, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the second Flicker copy, blinking Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Hexmage to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Invocation of the Founders, causing it to enter the battlefield as Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-3557-4377.notablePrerequisites: Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked an opponent.
1031-3557-4377.description:
Deal combat damage using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Walk the Aeons and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

671-3957-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
671-3957-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Daxos and gaining you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.
